facts.fact: Pro-Empresa reports on the Government of Cabo Verde's AfDB co-financed Fundo Morabeza (EUR 24m) that 1,774 MSMEs were funded in 2025 against a target of 600, with EUR 5.42m executed to 31 March 2026; the page presents the fund as boosting startups.

systems.owner: Government of Cabo Verde, co-financed by the African Development Bank

CPV.note: The document names no hub, incubator or technology park.
